bases.name: Halton Paramedic Services Headquarters, hub and Regional Emergency Operations Centre
bases.shortName: Halton Paramedic Services Headquarters, hub and Regional Emergency Operations Centre
bases.notes: New four-storey facility. Construction prequalification T-746-A-26 was awarded October 1, 2026; site-plan resubmissions continue in October 2026. It replaces the Woodlands headquarters at 1179 Bronte Road, but the operational transition is unknown. The 2024 master plan modeled operation from 2028; this has not been reconfirmed by the 2026 procurement.
